subject: Social Media
title: Digital Literacy as Defense
description: A micro-lesson that makes Digital Literacy as Defense usable.

hook.text: Finland teaches media literacy in schools. Kids learn to spot manipulation, check sources, and pause first.

buildup.text: Digital literacy means recognizing how platforms manipulate emotion. It's the difference between mob and mind.

discovery.text: Digitally literate people share misinfo 50% less. They pause before reacting. That pause changes everything.

twist.text: Most countries teach nothing about this. Kids get smartphones at 10 with zero training on manipulation.

climax.text: Platforms could add friction: 'Read the article first?' But friction cuts engagement. Speed is profitable.

punchline.text: The best defense against mobs is a pause button.

quiz.question: How much less do digitally literate people share misinformation?
